title_hook: Stone doesn't lose to force. It loses to return.
concept: The tide - stone yields not to the biggest wave but to the one that keeps returning
quote: Stone does not lose to force. It loses to return.
core_metaphor: Ocean tide versus basalt cliff: erosion by repetition, not impact.
primary_prompt: 9:16 vertical cinematic sequence: a towering black basalt cliff at night struck by a colossal wave that changes nothing, then tide cycles returning again and again, microscopic fractures yielding, ending with a carved sea arch in gold dawn light.

hook.text: You keep trying to break the wall in one wave. That is not how stone moves.
hook.visual: Extreme wide, 9:16 vertical: a single colossal wave rising in slow motion against a towering black basalt cliff (#0B1A24) at night. Bone-white (#F5F2EB) moonlight rims the crest. The wave detonates against the stone in hyper-detailed spray; the cliff does not move. Camera static, low angle.

build.text: One wave is noise. The shore does not remember it. But the tide comes back. Twice a day. Every day. Without asking permission.
build.visual: Time-lapse from a fixed vertical frame: the tide advancing and retreating across the cliff base again and again, day and night cycles flickering, gold (#C6A94F) sun glints on wet basalt each cycle. Fine mist, rhythmic, inevitable. No people.

pivot.text: Stone does not lose to force. It loses to return. The ocean wins by refusing to stop arriving.
pivot.visual: Macro slow push-in on the cliff face: microscopic fractures in the basalt glowing faint crimson (#DC143C) as seawater seeps in and withdraws. Grain by grain the stone gives way. Forensic detail, wet texture, cold light.

resolution.text: So stop measuring the wave. Measure the return. Show up again tomorrow. Smaller if you must. But show up.
resolution.visual: Medium shot rising slowly: a carved sea arch now stands where the cliff was solid, gold (#C6A94F) dawn light pouring through the opening onto calm water. Still, monumental, earned.

mobius_close.text: Because the cliff is not waiting for your strongest day. It is waiting to see if you...
mobius_close.visual: Wide shot, camera drifting forward over dark water toward a new unbroken basalt cliff at night, the next wave beginning to rise, bone-white (#F5F2EB) moonlight on the crest. Matches the opening geometry.

caption: Intensity gets applause. Return gets results. The cliff doesn't fall to one wave. It falls to the tide that keeps coming back.
